Spills Support

A color flood puzzle: fill the whole board with the goal color before you run out of moves.

Need help? Email spills.support@gmail.com. Tell us your device and, if it's about a level, the level number. We usually reply within a few days.

How do I play?

Your paint starts in the top-left corner. Tap a color: your paint turns that color and soaks up every matching bead it touches. If no bead of that color is touching, the move is wasted. Fill the whole board and finish on the goal color, within the move limit. If no bead of the goal color is left, you can still tap it last to turn your paint that color.

Why is one color button dimmed?

That's the color your paint already is, so tapping it wouldn't do anything.

Why did I lose with moves left?

The level ends as soon as it can't be won anymore: when there aren't enough moves left to cover the rest of the board and end on the goal color.

What are refills and skips?

A refill gives you 5 extra moves once, on a level you've run out of moves on. A skip passes a level you're stuck on, with one star.

I bought something but didn't get it / I got a new phone

Open the Shop and tap Restore purchases, signed in with the same Apple or Google account you bought with. Remove Ads and the Starter Bundle are restored. Refills and skips are used up as you play and can't be restored.

Refunds

Purchases are processed by Apple or Google, so refunds go through them: reportaproblem.apple.com for the App Store, or your Google Play order history.

My progress disappeared

Progress is saved on your device only. Deleting the app or moving to a new phone without a device backup starts you over.
